# UISizeConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")`

Keeps the size of its parent between a minimum and a maximum, such as a panel that is a third of the window but never less than 240 units wide. It is applied after the parent's own `Size` and before its children are laid out.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MaxSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.zero` | read/write | The largest size the object can have. 0 on an axis, the default, means no limit. `math.huge` also means no limit and reads back as 0. |
| `MinSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.zero` | read/write | The smallest size the object can have, in the object's units. |
